reading_note: The teaching describes how the human form is constituted as the receptacle of the whole spiritual and natural creation. Three operations are performed upon the First Man — divine truth descending into him: (1) the image of the Lord is impressed upon him, giving him exaltation above all degrees; (2) his very form is molded from the firstborn celestial substance and the Five Sons (the five degrees of reception), so that his structure differs from every other creature and his soul-mold extends through all the elements with a Mind elevated above natural affections; (3) the wisdom, counsels, and seal of all powers above and below are gathered and set within him as the houses of zodiac, stars, days, and years — meaning every spiritual state of the cosmos is inscribed in the human form. Because the seal of the entire spiritual cosmos is in him, all heaven and earth are moved on his account: goods are drawn toward life through the image upon him, evils toward death. The seven consequences then describe Adam as the Grand Man: he becomes an Illuminator bearing the icon of the Ambassador (divine truth descending); the powers of self-love seek to drain his light and hinder his ascent; the godhood humbles itself before the radiance set upon him; a new seal-character is impressed so all begettings are begotten before him; in him every art of every power is revealed and discriminated; great patronage rests upon him so the higher powers protect him from the archons; finally he is head, king, and lord, and through him the kingship is received. The arc is: image → form → knowledge, producing the Grand Man in whom all degrees of heaven and earth meet, through whom alone the kingship of life is received.
